characters.name: Tuck
characters.title: Acorn Tollkeeper
characters.design: cream speckled egg, oversized brown acorn cap with stem, green leaf vest, tiny wooden stamp
characters.before: Road toll! One shiny thing. Or a sandwich.
characters.after: That badge was doing most of the work.

characters.name: Bramble
characters.title: Fox Courier
characters.design: tangerine egg shell, cream belly, large fox ears, curled orange tail, small green satchel
characters.before: Express delivery! Unfortunately, it is another toll.
characters.after: I may have delivered that to myself.

characters.name: Morel
characters.title: Mushroom Bandit
characters.design: cream egg, russet mushroom cap, black cloth eye mask, red scarf, tiny seed pouch

characters.name: Pollen
characters.title: Pocket Gardener
characters.design: cream egg, moss curls around face, tiny flowers, leafy mitts, sprouting crown
characters.before: They charged my flowers a shade tax!
characters.after: Let us grow something better than toll booths.

characters.name: Sir Hoot
characters.title: Permit Inspector
characters.design: tawny owl egg, sculpted feather brows and winglets, small orange beak, tiny brass badge
characters.before: Do you have a permit for that shell?
characters.after: I appear to have filed my dignity incorrectly.

characters.name: Boggle
characters.title: Bog Bailiff
characters.design: olive frog egg, raised eye bumps, lily leaf collar, tiny muddy boots
characters.after: You may keep the puddle. It leaks.

characters.name: Captain Crack
characters.title: Acorn Admiral
characters.design: broad walnut armoured egg, enormous acorn helmet, green leaf cape, polished golden shell badge
characters.before: By the authority of my extremely important hat!
characters.after: I thought it said Golden Sheriff.

characters.name: Pipistrelle
characters.title: Night Post
characters.design: plum bat egg, huge purple ears, compact folded bat wings, moon shaped mail clasp
characters.after: Please sign here to confirm you already knew.

characters.name: Cinder
characters.title: Campfire Cook
characters.design: charcoal egg with glowing warm orange ember seams, tiny stone hands and feet, soot stained small apron
characters.before: Would you like your picnic toasted or geological?
characters.after: Next time I will try a smaller volcano.

characters.name: Prism
characters.title: Crystal Surveyor
characters.design: pale lavender stone egg, chunky amethyst growths, crooked small surveyor sash
characters.before: According to my map, your garden belongs to me.
characters.after: Oh. I was holding the map upside down.
